# Google Play Store Listing

Last updated: 2026-08-17

Use this file as the source of truth for Google Play Store presence updates.

## App name

Ritulaya

## Short description

Private period tracker with on-device predictions and optional GitHub sync

## Full description

Ritulaya is a privacy-first period tracker that keeps your data on your device and helps you understand your cycle with predictions computed entirely on your phone. No account, no cloud, no analytics.

Track your period and log how you feel each day. Ritulaya predicts your next period, fertile window, and ovulation day on-device, so your most sensitive data never leaves your phone. Your data is encrypted at rest and stays private unless you choose to sync it.

Why people use Ritulaya:

- Cycle tracking with period, fertile-window, and ovulation predictions
- Daily logging for flow intensity, symptoms, mood, and notes
- A calendar view with past periods and upcoming predictions across every month
- Insights like average cycle length, period length, and common symptoms and moods
- Optional reminders for your period and daily check-ins
- A discreet mode that masks sensitive labels
- Biometric app lock
- Optional GitHub sync to a private repository you own
- No ads, no analytics, no forced cloud account

What makes it different:

- Predictions are computed on-device, not in the cloud
- Your data is encrypted at rest with a hardware-backed key that never leaves your device
- GitHub sync is optional and uploads plaintext files to a repository you control
- Discreet mode and biometric lock keep the app private on a shared device
- The visual design shifts with your cycle in calm, muted tones

Track your cycle:

- Log period start and flow intensity
- See your cycle day and current phase at a glance
- Mark symptoms, mood, and notes for any day
- Browse a calendar of past periods and upcoming predictions

Understand your patterns:

- Average cycle length and period length
- Common symptoms and moods over time
- Fertile window and ovulation predictions

Optional GitHub sync:

- Sync to a private repository you own and control
- Works offline first and syncs when you choose
- Your repository copy is plaintext — you control its privacy

Private by design:

- No account required
- No analytics or advertising SDKs
- Cycle and day-log data never leaves your device unless you enable sync
- Only the notifications permission is requested, for optional reminders

Ritulaya is free and open source. You can report issues from the app's Settings screen or through the GitHub repository.

Privacy Policy: https://github.com/sudokoi/ritulaya/blob/main/privacy.md

## Store copy guardrails

Keep these claims accurate in Play Store updates:

- Describe Ritulaya as a period tracker, not a medical device, and do not imply it provides contraception or medical advice.
- Describe predictions as computed on-device.
- Describe GitHub sync as optional and as plaintext files in a repository the user owns.
- Describe biometric lock as using the device's biometrics; do not overstate security beyond the hardware-backed encryption key.
- Describe notifications as used only for optional period and daily-log reminders.
- Describe the app as Android-only.
- If future direction is mentioned, clearly label it as planned and not current behavior.
- Keep privacy claims aligned with [privacy.md](./../privacy.md).
